description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (Default): English

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The unique ID of the address.

description.zh:
地址探测异常切换方式：

- auto：自动模式（根据健康检查探测结果确定，探测异常停止解析，探测正常恢复解析）。

- manual：手动模式（异常状态下停止解析，健康检查正常也不会恢复解析；正常状态下恢复解析，健康检查异常也只是告警，但不会停止解析）。
description.en:
The failover method for the address. Valid values:

- auto: Automatic. The address status is determined by health check results. If a health check fails, DNS resolution stops. If it succeeds, DNS resolution resumes.

- manual: Manual. You control the address status. If set to abnormal, DNS resolution stops and does not resume even if health checks succeed. If set to normal, DNS resolution resumes. If a health check fails, an alert is triggered but resolution does not stop.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
当地址探测异常切换模式为manual时，地址设置的可用状态：

- available：正常，此状态下该地址正常解析，健康检查异常也只是告警，但不会停止解析。

- unavailable：异常，此状态下停止解析，健康检查正常也不会恢复解析。
description.en:
The availability status of the address. This parameter takes effect only when AvailableMode is set to manual. Valid values:

- available: Normal. The address is available. If a health check fails, an alert is triggered but DNS resolution continues.

- unavailable: Abnormal. DNS resolution for the address is stopped. It does not resume even if health checks succeed.

title.zh: 修改地址探测异常切换方式

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-manual-available-status --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --available-mode manual --manual-available-status available --region cn-hangzhou
